Suggestions to use gradient checkpointing, mixed precision, and early stopping as efficiency improvements are not mentioned in the chunks.

The framing that hardware and architecture choices are 'driven by fitting large U-Net–style diffusion models into memory' is only weakly implied; the text mentions fitting within memory constraints but not as the overarching design driver.

decisions.notes:
R1 (GPU memory footprint / cluster vs single node): unknown. The text notes an 'initial choice of hyperparameters ... to make network size fit within memory constraints' but gives no memory numbers or node count. [40de030796b3d32a]
R2 (high-res self-attention cost): architecture has self-attention only at 16×16, which suggests attention is not used at the highest 256×256 resolution, but there is no explicit discussion of cost optimization. [7e77adee2523ee5a]
R3 (parallelizability of training): no discussion of data/model parallelism or how diffusion’s sequential sampling affects training parallelism; only step rates are given. [e22df3321d2941a1]
R4 (initialization tricks to avoid pure noise): no mention of special initialization beyond standard architectural choices; nothing about preventing pure-noise outputs at start.
R5 (TPU-specific vs standard ops): they report using TPU v3-8 and TensorFlow Research Cloud, but do not describe TPU-only operations or portability to PyTorch/TensorFlow; implementation portability is unknown. [107be8a91170b1e2][e22df3321d2941a1]
